about.independent.p: CoffeeProof isn't a store and doesn't sell coffee or tea. Every price links to the store's own site, where purchases happen.
about.p: CoffeeProof follows the prices of independent coffee roasters and tea houses in the US, the UK and the EU. It tells a real price drop, measured against each product's own price history, from a store's own sale.
about.since.p: We started reading coffee and tea prices in October 2026; the site opened on 4 November 2026.
about.sisters.p: WheyProof (supplements in the US and the UK) and Protein Avcısı (supplements in Turkey) work the same way, on the same server.

faq.a1: We read every price once a day and keep the history. A product's usual price is the highest price it sold for on at least 7 of the last 30 days. A price under it is a real drop; if no day in the last 30 was cheaper, it's the lowest in 30 days.
faq.a2: The store shows its own crossed-out "was" price. We show it in amber and don't count it as a drop: a "was" price is the store's claim, our price history is the proof.
faq.a3: From each roaster's and tea house's own online shop, as a buyer in the US, the UK or the EU sees them. Shipping isn't included. Check the final price on the store's site before you buy.
faq.a4: Some stores convert their prices for other countries. A converted price can move with the exchange rate alone, so we count it as a drop only when the store's price in its own currency dropped too.
faq.a5: No. CoffeeProof is independent: it reads prices and links to the store. Purchases happen on the store's own site.

glossary.arabica.d: The coffee species most specialty coffee comes from; it grows best at altitude.
glossary.black.d: Tea whose leaves are fully oxidised.
glossary.blend.d: Coffees from several origins, mixed by the roaster for a steady taste.
glossary.camellia.d: The tea plant. Black, green, oolong, white and pu-erh teas all come from it.
glossary.chai.d: Tea brewed with spices, or a spice blend for it; usually based on black tea.
glossary.decaf.d: Coffee with most of its caffeine removed; US rules ask for at least 97%.
glossary.espresso_roast.d: A coffee its roaster roasts or recommends for espresso.
glossary.gesha.d: A coffee variety first found in Ethiopia, known from Panama's auction records.
glossary.green.d: Tea heated soon after picking, so the leaves don't oxidise.
glossary.herbal.d: An infusion of herbs, flowers, fruit or roots, such as rooibos or chamomile; not from the tea plant.
glossary.honey.d: The skin is removed but some of the sticky fruit is left on the bean while it dries.
glossary.lowest30.d: A real drop with no cheaper day in the last 30.
glossary.matcha.d: Shade-grown green tea ground into a powder and whisked into water.
glossary.natural.d: The whole coffee cherry dries with the bean inside, before the fruit is removed.
glossary.oolong.d: Tea whose leaves are partly oxidised, between green and black.
glossary.per_unit.d: The price for the same weight, to compare bags of different sizes: per kg for coffee, per 100 g for tea.
glossary.puerh.d: A tea from Yunnan, China, often pressed into cakes and aged.
glossary.real_drop.d: Today's price under the usual price, by our own price history.
glossary.roast_level.d: How long and how hot the beans were roasted: light, medium or dark.
glossary.robusta.d: A hardier coffee species with more caffeine, often used in espresso blends and instant coffee.
glossary.single_origin.d: Coffee from one country, region or farm, named after where it grew.
glossary.store_sale.d: A price the store shows against its own crossed-out "was" price; we don't count it as a drop.
glossary.usual.d: The highest price a size sold for on at least 7 of the last 30 days.
glossary.washed.d: The fruit is removed from the bean before drying.
glossary.white.d: Buds and young leaves, withered and dried with little handling.
glossary.whole_bean.d: Beans as roasted, or ground for a brew method.
how.amber.h: Amber is the store's own sale
how.amber.p: When a store shows a crossed-out "was" price, we show it in amber and don't count it as a drop. A "was" price is the store's claim; the price history is the proof.
how.categories.p: We sort products into categories by their names: an espresso is a coffee its roaster calls espresso. A product can be in more than one category.
how.converted.h: Converted prices need the store's own drop
how.converted.p: Some stores convert their prices for other countries. A converted price can move with the exchange rate alone, so it counts as a drop only when the store's price in its own currency dropped too.
how.green.p: Today's price is under the usual price. When no day in the last 30 was cheaper, it's the lowest in 30 days; with a longer history, the lowest since a date.
how.keep.p: Each size of each product has its own price history, from the first day we saw it.
how.list.p: Products in stock today, each by one size: a size with a real drop first, then one on sale, then the smallest bag. An offer we haven't seen for 48 hours leaves the list.
how.read.p: Once a day we read the public catalog of each roaster's and tea house's own online shop, as a buyer in the US, the UK or the EU sees it. Our crawler is shared with our sister sites: it calls itself wheyproofbot, signs its requests and follows each store's robots.txt. More about the crawler.
how.usual.p: A size's usual price is the highest price it sold for on at least 7 of the last 30 days. A price that lasted only a few days can't become the usual price.

privacy.cloudflare.p: Our pages are delivered through Cloudflare, which handles visitors' requests, including their IP addresses, to deliver and protect the site.
privacy.cookies.p: We set a cookie only when you use a control that needs one: the theme, the watchlist and the comparison. See the cookie policy.
privacy.log.p: Like most websites, our server keeps a log of the requests it answers: the IP address, the time, the page asked for (including what is in its address, such as a search or a calculator's numbers), the browser's user agent and the page you came from. We use it to keep the site running and safe, and it is deleted after 90 days. The server is in Frankfurt, Germany.
privacy.none.p: There are no accounts, no sign-up and no newsletter, and our pages carry no analytics or advertising trackers.
privacy.photos.p: Product photos load from each store's own image server (for most stores, Shopify's), so your browser asks that server for them. Our font is served from our own server.
privacy.rights.p: You can ask us what we hold about you, and to delete it. In the access log we can only find entries by IP address and time.
privacy.who.p: CoffeeProof (coffeeproof.org). Questions about this policy: support@wheyproof.com.
